The app now solves for maximum points rather than searching for good moves. One optimisation plans every Classic transfer, every hit, how many free transfers to bank, the eleven, the captain and the weeks for the wildcard, bench boost and triple captain, together, from gameweek 6 to gameweek 19. The Free Hit is priced week by week against that plan.

The plan is one you could follow: transfers are fixed only eight weeks ahead, a hit is taken only when it pays, and no player is sold just to be bought back later. Every planned week is re-checked by the app's own engine against the game's rules, and the whole plan is proven to be within half a per cent of the best that exists.
Draft: the best fifteen to gameweek 20 is solved from your roster plus every claimable player, then turned into an ordered claims sheet with a backup for each slot.

How this league settles waivers was read from its own transaction log and reproduced claim for claim: rounds, managers visited in waiver order, each trying their claims in the order lodged until one lands, nobody dropping to the bottom. The sheet is ordered for that rule and stress-tested against every rival claiming the names the model rates highest.

Prices moved on 22 September: Hall up to £5.3m, João Pedro and Bruno Fernandes down. Dunk is newly flagged (neck, 75%). Selling prices, gameweek 6 bookmaker prices and the transfer ledger carry forward.
